title: Q-ULTRA-blindspot-spend-UNMEASURED: essential variable blindspot:spend cannot be read
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** `blindspot:spend` has no fresh reading (source tenant.spend_vs_budget)
**Done check:** probe:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status
**Status:** open

An unmeasured variable is never in bounds and never a reason to change the system. Make the reading (probe, writer or fresh ledger row) so the loop can judge it.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --status` shows `blindspot:spend` with a value.
